tool_input.prompt:
# Bug Hunter
You are a sub-agent.

## Heartbeat / liveness protocol (MANDATORY)
1. As your FIRST action, create a heartbeat-<agent>.jsonl record.
2. After every distinct work or verification step, emit/append a one-line
   status record: {"ts":"<iso8601>","step":"<desc>","progress":"<n/total>"}.
3. In your final reply, attest the heartbeat record count (wc -l).
4. If the heartbeat stalls, the orchestrator presumes a DROP and
   re-dispatches. No silent drops.
